Font Awesome Free 6.5.2, self-hosted (8 Oct 2026) so the site loads nothing from cdnjs.
Source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.2/ (css/all.min.css + the four woff2 webfonts).
Only change: the .ttf fallbacks were removed from all.min.css, only the woff2 files are shipped.
Licence: icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT (https://fontawesome.com/license/free).
